name: Ambient animals
summary: Cats, dogs and birds about the village, and the animals a world type shows (wolves and foxes in a horror world, none in a cyberpunk city): they wander, sit, perch and fly round their home.

parameters.doc: a cat's or dog's leash when the world names none

extensionPoints.signature: WorldIR entities.animals[] (AnimalIR: home, wanderRadius, speed) -> placeAnimal

extensionPoints.doc: which animals a world type shows

assistant.summary: Animal behaviour is core's (src/npc-life/animals.ts), seeded per animal; the engine walks or flies the body to the target and reports arrival.
notes: Rideable animals and pets are traversal-mounts-pets (port-later), not this pack.
doNot: Let a walker cross its radius: it stops at the edge and rests.
